name: Attie Building
heritage: National Register of Historic Places contributing property
text: Attie Building, also known as Playmates of Hollywood Building,  is a historic two-story building located at 6436 W. Hollywood Boulevard in Hollywood, California. The building is notable for its second-floor Art Deco exterior as well as the 'You Are the Star' mural painted on its western-facing first floor exterior.
